governed_admission_mechanism.separation: Standard 6A states that the admission rule supplies no execution proof by itself and does not promote MD-S003-R0025. The governed mechanism therefore separates (A) technical proof admission and binding of the approved package to the executed target from (B) predicate promotion, which is decided by the proof basis, the G05 acceptance aggregate with its single-defect probes, the matrix and the binder. Only (A) was performed.
governed_admission_mechanism.not_invented: no new admission mechanism; the verifier gate and the aggregate were used as they are, no gate was weakened
